description: Who may reach production (D-054, enforcement audit 2026-10-26 rule 7, PS1).

production.cloud_session_markers.description: Environment variable names whose presence (non-empty) marks a cloud session; a host-side shell has none of them.

production.forbidden_entrypoints.description: The scripts under scripts/ that change or probe production; a cloud session never runs them and a PR diff never adds an invocation of them. Empty: OU-DECOUPLE F4 (D-111) took Open University's production entrypoints (ship-tail, neon-migrate, ship-verify, merge-phase, preview-deploy, production-check, neon-pr) out of the repository and the engine has no production deploy; an entrypoint that comes back is named here.

production.invocation_allowed_paths.description: Path globs where a diff may add a mention of a forbidden entrypoint: the entrypoints and delivery code themselves, the gate test map, the db-tier gate that predates the guard, and hermetic tests (fixtures and fake PATH only). Every other path is refused.

production.refusal_exit_code.description: Exit status of a production entrypoint that refuses to run in a cloud session.

production.scanned_roots.description: Path prefixes whose added lines the invocation scan reads.

production.scanned_suffixes.description: File suffixes the invocation scan reads under production.scanned_roots (the empty string is an extensionless script).
